CustomField.description: Comparison between Partner Discount from original (subscription) deal and Renewal.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__OptionType__c, "Component"), SBQQ__Quote__r.Account_Segment__c = "Public Sector", ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__OptionType__c, "Accessory"), ISBLANK( SBQQ__RenewedSubscription__c )),0, (SBQQ__RenewedSubscription__r.SBQQ__PartnerDiscount__c - SBQQ__PartnerDiscount__c ) )
CustomField.label: Partner Disc Change
